messages:
keiko: quick experiment update — ran a 'fast-prefill' speculative variant on titan-72b (4bit). p50 token latency ~ -18%, p99 ~ -12%. however QA EM down ~0.6% and we see occasional answer drift for >2k-token contexts. attaching quick logs.

maria: nice! can you paste the exact config you used? was sampling changed or only prefill logic?

keiko: config snippet:
```json
{
  "speculative_mode": "fast_prefill",
  "prefill_k": 2,
  "fallback_prob": 0.03,
  "quant": "4bit-qs8"
}
```
sampling params stayed the same (top_k=40, temp=0.2). prefill_k means we try 2 speculative tokens before committing to full decode.

jon: fwiw kernel folks flagged potential kv-stride misalignment with 4bit paths on long sequences — could cause subtle tokenization/context errors when trimming happens. did you run with kv-cache trimming?

keiko: yes, we trim every 512 tokens. the timing of drift spikes lines up with trimming events in the logs.

arjun: ops note — do NOT push to hosted API yet. plan: canary on Dedicated pool dp-redwood-fastprefill (1% traffic) only after offline eval and heatmap. rollback threshold = 0.5% EM regression or hallucination-rate +0.8% on any longform cohort.

eval-bot: quick eval summary: https://internal.eval/dashboard/run/6154321987 
EM: -0.6% | Rouge-L: -0.3 | Hallucination-rate (longform): +1.2% (significant). run used prod prompt distro, seeds=3.

maria: propose more controlled offline tests: 1) match prod prefix length distribution, 2) seeds=5, 3) break out cohorts (short/medium/long) and domain (qa/dialogue/code).

keiko: agree. I'm spinning a 10k-sample run with prod prefix distro + seeds=5 now (ETA ~3h). will include per-sample metadata: seed,prefill_k,trim_count.

jon: also add a lightweight consistency checker during decode to detect early semantic flip after a trimming event (cheap heuristic: ngram overlap drop > X within 5 tokens). if detected, mark sample for manual inspection.

arjun: ops requests: add these trace fields to the request: prefill_k, trimming_event_count, speculative_branch_taken (bool), fallback_triggered (bool). tag metrics with canary=true for the 1% run.

keiko: plan of action (short):
- finish 10k offline eval (prod distro)
- run canary on dp-redwood-fastprefill at 1% traffic, monitor EM/hallucination heatmaps
- implement early-consistency check + trace fields
- auto-fallback rule: route to titan-72b-quant-safe if hallucination-rate > 0.8% in any cohort

maria: small UX ask: capture exact model variant and quant bits in console, so we can filter regressions by quantization profile.

keiko: noted. I'll post intermediate eval artifacts and a short log excerpt when the run finishes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jon: thanks — also cc @kernel-team for the kv-stride note.

arjun: acked. will prepare the dp pool and add circuit-breaker for quick revert.

maria: thanks all. please ping in this thread when the 10k run completes and with the heatmap. :thumbsup:
